title: Writer Assistant Core raw extraction artifact storage and BookNLP fixture parser contract
goal: Publish the next safe Writer Assistant Core parent after the completed PHASE8-IMPL-007 mocked BookNLP adapter contract implementation. PHASE8-IMPL-008 prepares the project-local raw extraction artifact storage boundary and the mocked BookNLP-like fixture parser contract before any real extractor runtime exists. It defines and tests a storage root, run-folder shape, raw artifact kinds, and a fixture parser that turns in-memory TSV/JSON fixture text into raw artifact bundles acceptable to the existing validate_booknlp_raw_artifact_bundle API, while preserving non-canon, non-candidate, no-runtime-extraction, no-route, no-UI, no-package-change, no-canon-mutation, no-apply-promotion, and no-generated-prose boundaries. Real BookNLP install/run remains deferred.
why_now: PHASE8-IMPL-007 delivered the pure mocked BookNLP adapter contract implementation and normalization foundation with six public APIs, validators, mocked normalizers, candidate draft builder, fail-closed behavior, and source/evidence/provenance/raw-ref integration. The mocked adapter consumes raw artifact bundles but does not own a project-local storage boundary or a fixture parser. Before any real BookNLP install, the app needs a safe raw extraction artifact storage layout and a mocked fixture parser contract that keeps BookNLP/spaCy deferred and keeps raw artifacts and parsed fixture output out of canon, memory/canon, OMI candidates, and apply-promotion. This is the right next safe parent before any real extractor runtime is built.

context_tools_policy: No context tools, CCE, Graphify, Repomix, AI Context, MCP tools, or LeanCTX were run in T001.
external_tool_policy: T001 did not install packages, clone/fetch/pull repositories, retrieve web sources, run BookNLP, run spaCy, run dramatica-flow, run NCP tooling, run model calls, run Ollama, or execute external tools.
external_sources_policy: .external_sources/ is a local read-only evidence cache for prior parent source inventory, not an app dependency. .external_sources/ must not be committed, must not be staged, must not be vendored into backend/, must not be copied into app runtime files, must not be executed, and must not be imported. T001 confirms the four local clone paths exist and are protected via .git/info/exclude. T002 and T005 may reference the existing source inventory and decisions but must not clone, fetch, pull, install, run, import, vendor, or execute any external repository code.
candidate_only_policy: Raw extraction artifacts and parsed fixture output are not OMI candidate records and do not enter the candidate pipeline. A future reviewed converter must explicitly create candidate records. Tool outputs and imported structural data remain candidates with evidence/provenance until explicit owner approval. No candidate can mutate memory/canon automatically. Candidate drafts from build_booknlp_candidate_drafts are not persisted and not promoted in this parent.
raw_artifact_policy: Raw extraction artifacts under projects/{project_id}/writer_assistant/extractions/ are non-canon and non-candidate. They are raw support data only. They must never be treated as approved truth, project truth, memory/canon records, or OMI candidate records. They must never trigger apply-promotion. They must never be written into real project folders by T001 or by T002/T003/T004/T005/T006 unless explicitly authorized and limited to tmp_path test directories. The first tool-specific child folder is booknlp; the recommended run folder is projects/{project_id}/writer_assistant/extractions/booknlp/{run_id}/.
fixture_parser_policy: The BookNLP fixture parser is in-memory only. It consumes in-memory TSV/JSON fixture text and produces in-memory raw artifact bundles acceptable to validate_booknlp_raw_artifact_bundle. It must not read real BookNLP output from disk. It must not write real project artifacts. It must not produce candidate records. Its output is raw support data only and is non-canon, non-candidate, non-promotable. Owner review remains mandatory before any future converter can turn parsed fixture output into candidate records. The parser implementation is deferred to PHASE8-IMPL-009 unless T005 explicitly widens T006 into tests-first-plus-implementation.
source_evidence_policy: Source locators, stable source maps, source hashes, evidence spans, raw output provenance, and candidate normalization are already established as the foundation for the mocked adapter contract. PHASE8-IMPL-008 extends that foundation to raw extraction artifact storage and to a BookNLP-like fixture parser while preserving the existing source-map and evidence validation helpers in backend/story_knowledge/source_map.py and backend/story_knowledge/evidence.py. Parsed fixture bundles must carry source-map, evidence, raw output references, and normalization status where the existing booknlp_adapter_contract API expects them. BookNLP byte offsets remain raw support only; full byte-to-character source snapshot matching remains deferred.
